description: Header file defining the RialtoWebAudioSink class and related functions for GStreamer Web Audio Sink integration, including class structures, function prototypes, and macros.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSink
classes.description: Main class representing the Web Audio Sink element, inheriting from GstElement, with private data including web audio client and control client.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSinkClass
classes.description: Class structure for RialtoWebAudioSink, inheriting from GstElementClass.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSinkPrivate
classes.description: Private data structure holding web audio client, control client, and state flags.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_get_type
methods.description: Function to get the GType for RialtoWebAudioSink, used for GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_handle_rialto_server_state_changed
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the Rialto server.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_handle_rialto_server_eos
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream notification from the Rialto server.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_handle_rialto_server_error
methods.description: Handles error notifications from the Rialto server.
